title: Russian air defenses down 1,110 Ukrainian drones overnight
summary: On-duty air defense systems intercepted and destroyed fixed-wing drones over the Belgorod, Bryansk, Kursk, Ryazan, Tula, Kaluga, Vladimir, Nizhny Novgorod, Tambov, Voronezh, Lipetsk, Smolensk, Oryol, Rostov, Volgograd and Saratov regions, the Samara Region, the Krasnodar Region, the Moscow Region and the Republic of Crimea, as well as over the Black Sea

title: Russian forces hit tanker carrying military supplies for Ukrainian troops
summary: The footage shows a tanker hit by two Geran-4 Seeker drones in the port of Chernomorsk in the Odessa Region

title: Russian forces hit cargo ship, logistics center near Odessa
summary: The targets hit in the Odessa Region were a cargo ship in the port of Odessa that had delivered military supplies and the Novaya Pochta logistics center, located 1.5 km north of Odessa
